headline: A 2014 law renamed a Postal Service building in Burleson, Texas, after Sergeant William Moody.
what_it_does: This law gives a specific U.S. Postal Service facility at 232 Southwest Johnson Avenue in Burleson, Texas, the official name "Sergeant William Moody Post Office Building." It only changes the building's name and does not change how the post office operates. Mail service, postal rules, and fees are not affected.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 9, 2014, and the naming took effect on that date.
